function: Excluded (function): the learned D-MoENN networks detect the pilot spoofing attack and estimate the eavesdropper's locating cell, p. 8-9; the secure precoder is closed-form, p. 5.
notes: The only learned components are D-MoENN-PSA and D-MoENN-LOC. p. 8: "we propose a distributed MoE-based PSA detection neural network, called D-MoENN-PSA" (detects whether a pilot spoofing attack is present, by estimating the number of users on a pilot). p. 9: "we propose a D-MoENN-based localizer ... to identify the CF of Eve from the hybrid CFs and estimate the locating cell of Eve". The beamforming is not learned: p. 5 gives the MMSE-based LSFP with null-space artificial noise in closed form (Proposition 1), and p. 13 says "the closed-form expression of the MMSE-based LSFP is derived". The jamming base station is the one nearest to the estimated cell (p. 6, Algorithm 1 on p. 10). Attack detection and eavesdropper localization are the excluded functions of physical-layer authentication, anti-jamming and positioning or localization, and none of the seven areas (the channel is estimated by least squares, p. 4 eq. 6, not learned). Not a source_type, survey, no_learning or above_phy case: it is a research article with quantitative simulation results (Figs. 8-11, Table I on p. 10) and learning at the physical layer. The criteria are left empty because the work is excluded.
